mapper.select: SELECT PROD_NUM, PROD_CODE, PROD_CATEGORY, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, MANUFACTURER, REG_DATE FROM PRODUCT_INFO WHERE PROD_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY PROD_CATEGORY, PROD_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_INFO (PROD_CODE, PROD_CATEGORY, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, MANUFACTURER, PROD_STATUS) VALUES (#{prodCode}, #{prodCategory}, #{prodName}, #{prodPrice}, #{manufacturer}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_INFO SET PROD_CODE = #{prodCode}, PROD_CATEGORY = #{prodCategory}, PROD_NAME = #{prodName}, PROD_PRICE = #{prodPrice}, MANUFACTURER = #{manufacturer} WHERE PROD_NUM = #{prodNum}
